posts.title: AI Coding Agents Need a Source of Truth
posts.description: Bigger prompts do not fix drifting agent plans. A good workflow starts with a small brief, human review, task sizing, and checks against real artifacts.

posts.title: Good CLI Design Is Mostly Silence
posts.description: A CLI is both a user interface and an API for scripts. Quiet mode, stdout, stderr, colors, and exit codes need real contracts.

posts.title: The Build Cache Was Not Broken
posts.description: Docker cache problems are often Dockerfile problems: unstable inputs, bad COPY order, and layers that depend on too much.
